title: Tire Sets and Alignment Plans Bought on the Crestline Credit Card: Relationship Release on Holds
content:
On a Crestline Credit Card account, the relationship release eases the hold on a directed payment for a cardholder with Crestline service bought on the card: for a cardholder who holds an active Crestline tire set (Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty) paid with the Crestline card and an active Crestline alignment plan (Alignment Services & Plans) paid with the Crestline card, 0.2 of the held share is taken off it; for one who holds exactly one of the two, active and paid with the card, 0.1 of it is taken off; otherwise nothing is taken off.

**Records read.** For Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty, the cardholder's tire sets — status active and the tender used; for Alignment Services & Plans, the cardholder's alignment plans — status active and the tender used. Only the Crestline card as tender counts.

| Active tire set paid with the Crestline card | Active alignment plan paid with the Crestline card | Fraction of the held share taken off |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.2 |
| yes | no | 0.1 |
| no | yes | 0.1 |
| no | no | nothing |

Hypothetical case: an active tire set bought on the Crestline card and an alignment plan bought in cash — 0.1 of the held share is taken off; with nothing else taken off, a held share of 0.15 becomes 0.135.
